feed.title: Single-Cell Foundation Model Tracker — weekly changes
feed.subtitle: What moved in the single-cell foundation model field this week: new models, rank changes, repositories going quiet, and new benchmarking papers.

entry.title: Week of 2026-10-19: 5 changes
entry.content:
• New evaluation — “Artificial intelligence (AI)‐enabled RNA therapeutic design: from molecular optimization to system‐level evaluation” (British Journal of Pharmacology) — covers scGPT, Geneformer. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Benchmarking single-cell format conversion tools reveals interoperability gaps and introduces CrossCell for reliable cross-ecosystem data exchange” (BMC Genomics) — covers scGPT, Geneformer. DOI
  • New evaluation — “How do Large Language Models understand Genes and Cells” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Evaluating the Utilities of Foundation Models in Single-cell Data Analysis” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers CellPLM. DOI
  • Citations — 53 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.

entry.title: Week of 2026-10-14: 9 changes
entry.content:
• Upkeep — UCE (Universal Cell Embeddings)'s repository has slowed — no commit in over 90 days.
  • Upkeep — Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale's repository is being actively developed again.
  • New evaluation — “Benchmarking biological knowledge-graph priors against single-cell foundation models for Perturb-seq prediction” (Computational Biology and Chemistry) — covers scGPT, Geneformer, scBERT, scFoundation. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Benchmarking biochemical networks generated by large language models” (eLife) — covers scGPT. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Evaluating the Utilities of Foundation Models in Single‐Cell Data Analysis” (Advanced Science) — covers SCimilarity. DOI
  • New evaluation — “Stereopy: modeling comparative and spatiotemporal cellular heterogeneity via multi-sample spatial transcriptomics” (Nature Communications) — covers Geneformer. DOI
  • New evaluation — “singletCode: Synthetic Barcodes Identify Singlets in scRNA-seq Datasets and Evaluate Doublet Algorithms” (bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)) — covers SCimilarity. DOI
  • Citations — 48 other citing papers newly indexed, none of them evaluations.
  • First comparison — First joint evaluation of CellFM and SCimilarity.
